user.title: 15-minute average power
user.description: Calculates the 15-minute average power of a power sensor, in fixed quarter hours (:00, :15, :30, :45), as the electricity meter does.

data_description.source_entity: A sensor in W or kW. For the grid, use the power at the meter.
data_description.name: Optional. The default is the name of the power sensor.
data_description.import_only: Turn on when the sensor is negative during export (solar). Negative values then count as 0 W.

error.unsupported_unit: The sensor must be in W or kW.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor already has a 15-minute average.
